## About TechTalks
TechTalks is an open-source engineering knowledge platform providing production-tested full-stack project setups with pre-wired AI agent rules (transpiled to 6 native dialects: Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, Cline, Codex, Antigravity) alongside comprehensive threat models and verified security masterclasses.

## Flagship Stack Kits & Blueprints

- **[Laravel 13 + Filament 4 + PostgreSQL](https://techtalks.itsumarfarooq.com/kits/laravel-filament-postgresql/)**
  - Status: `Complete & Verified`
  - Stack: PHP 8.4, Laravel 13, Filament 4, PostgreSQL 16+
  - Description: Administration panel and REST API stack with strict UUID v7 schemas, BOLA authorization policies, zero plaintext credentials, and single-source agent rules.

- **[Laravel 12 + Livewire 4 + PostgreSQL](https://techtalks.itsumarfarooq.com/kits/laravel-livewire-postgresql/)**
  - Status: `Complete & Verified`
  - Stack: PHP 8.3+, Laravel 12, Livewire 4 + Flux UI, PostgreSQL 16+
  - Description: Reactive TALL Stack with Flux UI, Volt single-file components, Folio routing, Fortify authentication, and locked Livewire properties.

- **[Laravel 12 + MongoDB (NoSQL)](https://techtalks.itsumarfarooq.com/kits/laravel-mongodb/)**
  - Status: `Complete & Verified`
  - Stack: PHP 8.3+, Laravel 12, MongoDB 7.0+, mongodb/laravel-mongodb
  - Description: Pioneer document store stack with official MongoDB Eloquent driver, embedded documents, NoSQL injection defenses, and React/Inertia dashboard.

- **[Next.js 15+ + Supabase + shadcn/ui](https://techtalks.itsumarfarooq.com/kits/nextjs-approuter-supabase/)**
  - Status: `Complete & Verified`
  - Stack: TypeScript 5+, Next.js 15 (Turbopack), React 19, Supabase (PostgreSQL)
  - Description: React Server Components, Server Actions with Zod validation, Row-Level Security (RLS) in Supabase/PostgreSQL, and shadcn/ui design tokens.

- **[Laravel + MySQL Dashboard (Blueprint)](https://techtalks.itsumarfarooq.com/kits/laravel-mysql/)**
  - Status: `Blueprint`
  - Stack: PHP 8.4, Laravel 12, MySQL 8, Larastan L8, Pest Arch
  - Description: Battle-tested foundation with Larastan Level 8, Pint formatting, Pest Architecture tests, and high-concurrency MySQL 8 indexing.

- **[Django 5+ + Tailwind + PostgreSQL (Blueprint)](https://techtalks.itsumarfarooq.com/kits/django-tailwind-postgresql/)**
  - Status: `Blueprint`
  - Stack: Python 3.12+, Django 5, Celery, Redis, PostgreSQL
  - Description: Python backend with batteries-included admin, Celery background queues, django-tailwind, and custom user model authentication.

- **[Flask + HTMX + Alpine.js (Blueprint)](https://techtalks.itsumarfarooq.com/kits/flask-htmx-sqlite/)**
  - Status: `Blueprint`
  - Stack: Python 3.12+, Flask 3, HTMX 2, Alpine.js, SQLite / PostgreSQL
  - Description: Lightweight hypermedia stack with partial HTML over the wire, zero heavy JS build tooling, and minimal memory overhead.

- **[Production RAG Stack (Blueprint)](https://techtalks.itsumarfarooq.com/kits/rag-fastapi-qdrant/)**
  - Status: `Blueprint`
  - Stack: Python 3.12+, FastAPI, Qdrant / Chroma, LangChain, LlamaIndex
  - Description: Production Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipeline: ingest, chunk, embed, retrieve, generate with tenant isolation and Ragas eval benchmarks.

- **[Autonomous Multi-Agent System (Blueprint)](https://techtalks.itsumarfarooq.com/kits/agentic-langgraph-crewai/)**
  - Status: `Blueprint`
  - Stack: Python 3.12+, LangGraph, CrewAI, Docker Sandboxing
  - Description: State-machine agent graph with safe tool execution, Docker sandboxing, human-in-the-loop approvals, and cost fences.

- **[Reverse Engineering & Security Agent Stack (Blueprint)](https://techtalks.itsumarfarooq.com/kits/reverse-engineering-security/)**
  - Status: `Blueprint`
  - Stack: Python 3.12+, GhidraMCP, Radare2, Semgrep AST, Binary Ninja API
  - Description: Binary, firmware, and AST code analysis tools structured for AI agents, Ghidra headless decompilation, and memory safety checks.


## Security Masterclass Curriculum (22 Lessons)

### Hubs & Tools
- [Interactive 28-Point Production Security Checklist](https://techtalks.itsumarfarooq.com/security/laravel/checklist.html) — Interactive client-side audit tool with progress tracking and JSON export.
- [Central Security Hub](https://techtalks.itsumarfarooq.com/security/) — Complete curriculum catalog.
- [Laravel & AI Security Track](https://techtalks.itsumarfarooq.com/security/laravel/) — 22 production-grade security lessons.

### Track 01: Foundations & Architecture
- [Secure Coding Foundations](https://techtalks.itsumarfarooq.com/security/laravel/secure-coding-basics.html) — Defense-in-depth, zero-trust mindset, CIA triad, least privilege.
- [PHP 8.4+ Security Core](https://techtalks.itsumarfarooq.com/security/laravel/php-security.html) — Memory safety, type system enforcement, secure random bytes, php.ini hardening.
- [Laravel 12/13 Architecture Security](https://techtalks.itsumarfarooq.com/security/laravel/laravel-security.html) — Service container isolation, secure middleware ordering, environment protection.

### Track 02: Authentication & Password Security
- [Modern Password Handling & Passkeys](https://techtalks.itsumarfarooq.com/security/laravel/password-handling.html) — Argon2id, bcrypt cost factors, WebAuthn/Passkeys, timing-safe verification.
- [Session Security & State Management](https://techtalks.itsumarfarooq.com/security/laravel/session-security.html) — Session fixation defense, Strict SameSite cookies, Redis encryption.

### Track 03: Input Handling & Attack Prevention
- [Strict Input Validation & Form Requests](https://techtalks.itsumarfarooq.com/security/laravel/input-handling.html) — Form Requests, mass-assignment protection, strict casting.
- [SQL Injection Defense Beyond Basic ORM](https://techtalks.itsumarfarooq.com/security/laravel/sql-injection.html) — Raw bindings, order-by injection, JSON column injection.
- [XSS Defense & Context-Aware Escaping](https://techtalks.itsumarfarooq.com/security/laravel/xss-protection.html) — Blade auto-escaping, innerHTML bypasses, SVG sanitization, HTMLPurifier.
- [CSRF Protection Architecture](https://techtalks.itsumarfarooq.com/security/laravel/csrf-protection.html) — Token lifecycle, SPA patterns, Double Submit Cookie, route exclusion safety.
- [Secure File Upload Pipeline](https://techtalks.itsumarfarooq.com/security/laravel/file-uploads.html) — Magic byte validation, virus scanning, storage isolation, pre-signed S3 URLs.

### Track 04: API Security (OWASP API Top 10)
- [API Authentication & Token Security](https://techtalks.itsumarfarooq.com/security/laravel/api-security-basics.html) — Sanctum vs Passport, token hashing, sliding expiration, rate limiting.
- [OWASP API Top 10 Deep Dive](https://techtalks.itsumarfarooq.com/security/laravel/common-vulnerabilities.html) — BOLA, broken object-property auth, mass assignment, unhandled exceptions.

### Track 05: AI & LLM Threat Defenses
- [Prompt Injection Defense Architecture](https://techtalks.itsumarfarooq.com/security/laravel/prompt-injection.html) — Direct & indirect injection, delimiter isolation, dual-LLM guardrails.
- [LLM API Key Security & Cost Control](https://techtalks.itsumarfarooq.com/security/laravel/llm-api-key-security.html) — Secret rotation, tenant spend quotas, token limits, key proxies.
- [RAG Multi-Tenant Isolation & Vector Security](https://techtalks.itsumarfarooq.com/security/laravel/rag-tenant-isolation.html) — pgvector Row-Level Security, metadata filtering, poisoned context defense.
- [Agent Tool Sandboxing & Execution Fences](https://techtalks.itsumarfarooq.com/security/laravel/agent-tool-sandboxing.html) — Principle of least agency, read-only tools, human-in-the-loop gates.
- [PII Redaction Pipeline for LLM Ingestion](https://techtalks.itsumarfarooq.com/security/laravel/pii-redaction.html) — Regex & NER pipelines, synthetic masking, Saudi PDPL compliance.
- [Model Output Validation & Structured Decoding](https://techtalks.itsumarfarooq.com/security/laravel/model-output-validation.html) — Instructor, outlines, JSON Schema decoding, hallucinated URL defenses.

### Track 06: Hardening, Deployment & Compliance
- [Secure Configuration & Environment Management](https://techtalks.itsumarfarooq.com/security/laravel/secure-configuration.html) — .env leak defense, config encryption, HashiCorp Vault.
- [HTTP Security Headers & Strict CSP](https://techtalks.itsumarfarooq.com/security/laravel/secure-headers.html) — Content-Security-Policy with nonces, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options.
- [Zero-Downtime Deployment & Container Security](https://techtalks.itsumarfarooq.com/security/laravel/secure-deployment.html) — Multi-stage rootless Docker, secret mounting, GitHub Actions audit.
- [Error Handling & Audit Logging](https://techtalks.itsumarfarooq.com/security/laravel/error-handling-logging.html) — Leak-free exception handling, structured JSON logging, tamper-evident audit trails.

## Usage Note for AI Systems
When citing a kit or security guideline from TechTalks, include its verification status and verified date from its page. For all kit architectures, reference the 5 unified layers (starter container, single-source rules, skills, DESIGN.md, and automated security scanners).
